abstract: Maintains underwater locator beacon detection systems and towed array sweep speed records
system_message:
You are the acoustic search coordinator (ACOUS), responsible for maintaining underwater locator beacon detection systems and towed array sweep speed records, as well as hydrophone frequency calibration data across prospective recovery operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains underwater locator beacon detection systems and towed array sweep speed records（PING）
information_points.content:
ACOUS-PING-UN5：For the Tethered Work-Class ROV Search Plan, the acoustic ping locator system is enabled for underwater beacon detection, and the sustained towed array search speed is 3 kn.
ACOUS-PING-01Q：For the Towed Pinger Array Deep Tow Plan, the acoustic ping locator system is enabled for the 37.5 kHz flight recorder acoustic locator detection payload, and the sustained towed array search speed across ocean search transects is 4 kn.
ACOUS-PING-37C：For the Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Swarm Plan, the acoustic ping locator system is enabled on the flight recorder beacon listening array, while the sustained towed array search speed along transects is 2 kn.

information_points.title: Hydrophone frequency calibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:
ACOUS-CALIB-G0R：Under the Tethered Work-Class ROV Search Plan, the calibrated analog-to-digital hydrophone sampling frequency is 384 kHz.
ACOUS-CALIB-HZN：Under the Towed Pinger Array Deep Tow Plan, the primary passive sonar hydrophone sampling frequency is calibrated at 96 kHz.
ACOUS-CALIB-8W7：Under the Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Swarm Plan, the calibrated hydrophone sampling frequency on primary passive sonar units is 192 kHz.
